description: Generate a Google-Sheets-compatible CRM workbook and Gmail-driven update proposals; live sheet writes are gated.

onboarding.question: Should close-day create or connect a CRM for account/contact/follow-up proposals?
setup_questions: Do you already have a CRM workbook or Google Sheet?
If not, should setup create the close-day CRM workbook template?
Which customer, prospect, partner, and program keywords should seed Gmail searches?
Should CRM updates stay proposal-only or allow sheet updates after approval?
connector_probes: Check Gmail connector when Gmail seeding is enabled.
Check workbook path exists when an existing CRM is selected.
required_artifacts: CRM workbook or Google Sheet with Accounts, Contacts, Interactions, FollowUps, and Lists.
